help.title: About Shipping Zones
help.overview: Shipping zones decide which delivery options the buyer is offered at checkout and what they cost. A zone lists countries, optionally states and postal codes, and one or more rates. Checkout offers every rate of every active zone that matches; the buyer picks one.

sections.title: Matching a destination
items: The destination country must be one of the zone's countries; a zone with no countries matches nothing.
Listed states narrow it; empty states cover the whole country. Postal patterns are optional and use * as the only wildcard.
Without a destination country, no rates are offered.

sections.title: Rate types
sections.body: Each rate shows its name, price, carrier, and estimated days. Carrier and days do not change the price.
items: Free charges nothing, and is hidden when the order amount is outside its minimum or maximum, which is how "free over 50" is built.
Weight charges its price when the cart weight is inside its minimum and maximum weight.
Price charges its price when the merchandise subtotal is inside its minimum and maximum order amount.
Quantity charges its price when the number of items is inside the minimum and maximum order amount fields (they are read as item counts for this type).

sections.title: Together with discounts and orders
items: A free-shipping discount waives the charge but does not hide the rates.
The chosen rate's name, carrier, and price are copied onto the order.
Activate and deactivate switch the zone on and off. Deleting is a soft delete and it can be restored.
